verdict.rationale: Runpod documents official Serverless SDKs for Python, JavaScript and Go for working with endpoints programmatically. It also documents an official `@runpod/ai-sdk-provider` package that gives a type-safe Vercel AI SDK interface to Public Endpoints. The SDK coverage shown is scoped to Serverless and Public Endpoints: Pod, cluster and volume management is evidenced only through the REST/GraphQL APIs and the CLI, not an SDK. missing for 10: evidence of SDK coverage beyond Serverless and Public Endpoints (Pods, clusters, volumes), depth of SDK reference docs, independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: Install and configure the Serverless SDK for Python, JavaScript, or Go to interact with Serverless endpoints programmatically.

The `@runpod/ai-sdk-provider` package integrates Runpod Public Endpoints with the [Vercel AI SDK](https://ai-sdk.dev/docs/introduction). This gives you a streamlined, type-safe interface for text generation, streaming, image generation, and video generation
